song_craft: Bargaining-and-confession song (25v): fickle-praised (v1) → low-ground-kept (v2) → road-begged (v3) → four-name-cry (v4) → foot-throne laughter (v5) → ever-won (v6) → stale-vs-fresh (v7) → lightning-mind (v8) → bare-plea (v9) → folk-walking (v10) → heart-bloom (v11) → fattened-love (v12) → slant-hearts (v13) → face-din (v14) → no-knocking (v15) → face-hunger (v16) → wrong-road (v17) → serfdom-sipping (v18) → unheard-wail (v19) → one-wish (v20) → fair-hundreds (v21) → Śiva-night (v22) → sapless-rule (v23) → tough-bond (v24) → SEAL worshiper-shaped-God (v25). Bhakti-karuṇa bargaining to the end.

lines: Fickle though thou be, mind —
praised even so, since thou courtst the refuge of refuges, worlds' teacher, Ambikā's husband.
l4.sanskrit_cite: capalam asi yad api mānasa tatrāpi ślāghyase yato bhajase | śaraṇānām api śaraṇaṃ tribhuvanagurum ambikākāntam

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Stairs of sundry gods climbed past, Śiva's feet reached and held —
yet the low ground I keep even today. Strange — I quit it not.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ullaṅghya vividhadaivatasopānakramam upeya śivacaraṇān | āśrityāpy adharatarāṃ bhūmiṃ nādyāpi citram ujjhāmi

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Show Thine own road, shutter all world-doings tight —
while I am, Lord, Thy servant now, ever risen.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakaṭaya nijam adhvānaṃ sthagayatarām akhilalokacaritāni | yāvad bhavāmi bhagavaṃs tava sapadi sadodito dāsaḥ

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Śiva! Śiva! Śambhu! Śaṅkara! O lover of comers-for-shelter —
pity, and swift! Who bends on remembering Thy paired lotus-feet — fortunes, not far.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śiva śiva śambho śaṅkara śaraṇāgatavatsalāśu kuru karuṇām | tava caraṇakamalayugalasmaraṇaparasya hi sampado 'dūre

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Dissolved in Thy foot-lotus seat, making the world to taste —
they laugh at Viriñci, office-smeared, unmastered by himself, Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tāvakāṅghrikamalāsanalīnā ye yathāruci jagad racayanti | te viriñcim adhikāramalenāliptam asvavaśam īśa hasanti

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Naught can show apart from Thy light-body —
so, Lord, art Thou ever already won, Master, though far by nature.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvatprakāśavapuṣo na vibhinnaṃ kiṃ cana prabhavati pratibhātum | tat sadaiva bhagavan parilabdho 'sīśvara prakṛtito 'pi vidūraḥ

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Thy foot-lotus sap — some sup as overnight-stale difference-fare;
but some taste it fresh-poured: shining, whole-bodied, void of two.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pādapaṅkajarasaṃ tava ke cid bhedaparyuṣitavṛttim upetāḥ | ke canāpi rasayanti tu sadhyo bhātam akṣatavapur dvayaśūnyam

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Lord, like daybreak lightning shines my nectar-smeared —
would she hold but steadier, then art Thou duly worshipped. What more?
l4.sanskrit_cite: nātha vidyud iva bhāti vibhāte yā kadā cana mamāmṛtadigdhā | sā yadi sthirataraiva bhavet tat pūjito 'si vidhivat kim utānyat

verses.craft: Daybreak-lightning mind; she-steadier plea (feminine kept bare per note).
verses.rejected: (a) she→it → killed bare. (b) What-more kept (no answer).
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['Feminine subject unexpressed in Sanskrit (mānasī/mati implied); kept bare per Bar 6.']) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: 'Thing or unthing —
is aught beyond this?' thus with high discernment resolved: as Thou art, be Thou bare to me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvam asyaparam asti na kiṃ cid vastv avastu yadi veti mahatyā | prajñāya vyavasito 'tra yathaiva tvaṃ tathaiva bhava suprakaṭo me

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: By Thine own will alone, Lord, on Thine own road I was set walking —
by the Lord Himself. Why then walk I mere folk-like, kenning naught worthy of Thy feet?
l4.sanskrit_cite: svecchayaiva bhagavan nijamārge kāritaḥ padam ahaṃ prabhunaiva | tat kathaṃ janavad eva carāmi tvatpadocitam avaimi na kiṃ cit

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Some god of Thine blooms in their hearts — a lovely high mood.
Thy story-cloud's thunder — its cātakas, by it made lovely, long.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ko 'pi deva hṛdi teṣu tāvako jṛmbhate subhagabhāva uttamaḥ | tvatkathāmbudaninādacātakā yena te 'pi subhagīkṛtāś ciram

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Thy partakers — by some play in Thee this love has grown fat:
on parting-ground, talk, remembrance too, fruit a union-feast.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvajjuṣāṃ tvayi kayāpi līlayā rāga eṣa paripoṣam āgataḥ | yad viyogabhuvi saṅkathā tathā saṃsmṛtiḥ phalati saṃgamotsavam

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Grown by strange-sap watering — 'Śaṅkara!' hundredfold though uttered —
the word slips even into slant hearts, its errand ever fresh.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yo vicitrarasasekavardhitaḥ śaṅkareti śataśo 'py udīritaḥ | śabda āviśati tiryagāśayeṣv apy ayaṃ navanavaprayojanaḥ

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: They win on whose face-orbs circles ever the Śiva-din —
which, moonlike, streaming from nectar's seat, trickles sweet supreme nectar.
l4.sanskrit_cite: te jayanti mukhamaṇḍale bhraman asti yeṣu niyataṃ śivadhvaniḥ | yaḥ śāśīva prasṛto 'mṛtāśayāt svādu saṃsravati cāmṛtaṃ param

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: The fierce world as if done; mind-stain melted thin —
yet at Thy city, bolt-and-door, not one atom of knocking.
l4.sanskrit_cite: parisamāptam ivogram idaṃ jagad vigalito 'viralo manaso malaḥ | tad api nāsti bhavatpurārgalakavāṭavighaṭṭanam aṇva pi

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Hungry for one gaze into Thy ever-bloom face-lotus's heart —
do aught, Lord, the merest: flash Thou facing me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: satataphullabhavanmukhapaṅkajodaravilokanalālasacetasaḥ | kim api tat kuru nātha manāg iva sphurasi yena mamābhimukhasthitiḥ

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: What joy here but thought of Thy undifference — what other glory?
Why then does this slave of Thine go wrong-road, forsaking her?
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvadavibhedamater aparaṃ nu kiṃ sukham ihāsti vibhūtir athāparā | tad iha tāvakadāsajanasya kiṃ kupatham eti manaḥ parihṛtya tām

verses.craft: Wrong-road forsaking-her (matim feminine per note); glory-question.

lines: Never for an instant here unfit for Thy serfdom may I be —
unless I sip, loving, unceasing, Thy undifference-wine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kṣaṇam apīha na tāvakadāsatāṃ prati bhaveyam ahaṃ kila bhājanam | bhavadabhedarasāsavam ādarād avirataṃ rasayeyam ahaṃ na cet

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Folk see not, truly, Thy body — two-sight-dirtied. Yet Thou, all-knowing, shelter-tender —
why hearest Thou not this wail of mine?
l4.sanskrit_cite: na kila paśyati satyam ayaṃ janas tava vapur dvayadṛṣṭimalīmasaḥ | tad api sarvavidāśritavatsalaḥ kim idam āraṭitaṃ na śṛṇoṣi me

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Rememberest Thou, Lord, e'er a sense-joy I wished —
or e'er asked? Give ever Thy body-beholding nectar — my one wish. Give it.
l4.sanskrit_cite: smarasi nātha kadācid apīhitaṃ viṣayasaukhyam athāpi mayārthitam | satatam eva bhavadvapurīkṣaṇāmṛtamabhīṣṭamalaṃ mama dehi tat

verses.craft: Sense-joy wished? No — body-nectar one-wish; Give-it doubled.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Since foot I've set, Great-Lord, on Thy Śiva-road — by Thy will —
fair hundreds rose for me at once. What more hunt I from Thee, Master?
l4.sanskrit_cite: kila yadaiva śivādhvani tāvake kṛtapado 'smi maheśa tavecchayā | śubhaśatānyuditāni tadaiva me kim aparaṃ mṛgaye bhavataḥ prabho

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Where sun goes down with moon and all their train —
what a Śiva-night reigns, self-light outspread and lustrous.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yatra so 'stam ayam eti vivasvāṃś candramaḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ saha sarvaiḥ | kāpi sā vijayate śivarātriḥ svaprabhāprasarabhāsvararūpā

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Three worlds' overlordship won — yet, God-king, I reckon it sapless, all —
wanting Thy foot-touch nectar-sap.
l4.sanskrit_cite: apy upārjitam ahaṃ triṣu lokeṣv adhipatyam amareśvara manye | nīrasaṃ tad akhilaṃ bhavadaṅghrisparśanāmṛtarasena vihīnam

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Alas, Lord — tough, this self-bond, Thy-unrecognition-made, tied by Thee alone:
scorning Thee first of all, it slackens not one jot.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bata nātha dṛḍho 'yam ātmabandho bhavadakhyātimayas tvayaiva kḷptaḥ | yad ayaṃ prathamānam eva me tvām avadhīrya ślathate na leśato 'pi

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: God-king — though worshipped by the great, ever Thou standest worshiper-shaped alone;
seen without, within, here, Thou flashest in seer-bodies — ever.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mahatām amareśa pūjyamāno 'py aniśaṃ tiṣṭhasi pūjakaikarūpaḥ | bahirantarapīha dṛśyamānaḥ sphurasi draṣṭṛśarīra eva śaśvat
